scenes.name: opening
scenes.prompt: An immense split pomegranate floats above an ink-blue ocean at night. Its cut half is very close along the left edge, a sweeping dark crimson rind curling overhead like a theatre balcony. Inside the fruit, luminous amber seeds are miniature windows and staircases. A wide opening between the seeds reveals a tiny bright golden city near the center-right. One long ivory staircase descends from the fruit toward the water, where the small city is reflected. A thin turquoise moon hangs far to the right. The fruit is cropped by the top and left edges; the distant city has clear breathing room.
